cards.question: What are the four domains of ANTS (Anaesthetists' Non-Technical Skills)?
cards.answer: Task management, team working, situation awareness and decision making — each with behavioural markers used for structured debrief and assessment (Fletcher et al., BJA 2003).

cards.question: What is the difference between 'shared mental model' and 'situation awareness'?
cards.answer: Situation awareness is individual perception of cues, comprehension and projection (Endsley); shared mental model is the team-wide common understanding of the problem and plan — built by closed-loop communication and structured handover (e.g. SBAR).

cards.question: How does cognitive aid use improve crisis management?
cards.answer: Cognitive aids (e.g. AAGBI Quick Reference Handbook, ASA Critical Events) reduce omission errors in low-frequency emergencies — RCTs show measurable improvement when a dedicated reader is appointed within the team.
